Paramārthacarcā

8 verses chanted, karaoke-timed · English shows only where the gate passed
8 versesstudio chant AI voice0.00 mean align8/8 with English
line mode: Sanskrit line-by-line, English follows each verse
1
अर्केन्दुदीपाद्यवभासभिन्नम् नाभात्यतिव्याप्ततया ततश्च
प्रकाशरूपम् तदियत् प्रकाश्यप्रकाशताख्या व्यवहार एव
arkendudīpādyavabhāsabhinnaṃ nābhātyativyāptatayā tataśca |
prakāśarūpaṃ tadiyat prakāśyaprakāśatākhyā vyavahāra eva ||
Distinct from the illumination of sun, moon, lamp and the rest, it does not shine — on account of over-pervasion; and hence: of the nature of light, just this much — illumined-illuminator named is mere convention.
studio chant · upajati · align 0.0
2
ज्ञानद्विभिन्नो न हि कश्चिदर्थः तत्तत्कृतः संविदि नास्ति भेदः
स्वयम्प्रकाशाच्छतमैकधाम्नि प्रातिस्विकी नापि विभेदिता स्यात्
jñānadvibhinno na hi kaścidarthaḥ tattatkṛtaḥ saṃvidi nāsti bhedaḥ |
svayaṃprakāśācchatamaikadhāmni prātisvikī nāpi vibheditā syāt ||
No thing at all is dually distinct from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no difference. From self-luminosity, hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would not indeed be divided.
studio chant · upajati · align 0.0
3
इत्थम् स्वसंविद्घन एक एव शिवः स
विश्वस्य परः प्रकाशः तत्रापि भात्येव विचित्रशक्तौ ग्राह्मगृहीतृप्रविभागभेदः
itthaṃ svasaṃvidghana eka eva śivaḥ sa |
viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ| tatrāpi bhātyeva vicitraśaktau grāhmagṛhītṛpravibhāgabhedaḥ ||
Thus — dense own-consciousness, one indeed: he is Śiva, the universe's supreme light. There too, indeed, shines, in variegated power: apprehended-apprehender-division-difference.
studio chant · gadya · align 0.0
4
भेदः स चायम् न
ततो विभिन्नः स्वच्छन्दसुस्वच्छतमैकधाम्नः प्रासादहस्त्यश्वपयोदसिन्धुगिर्यादि यद्वन्मणिदर्पणादेः
bhedaḥ sa cāyaṃ na |
tato vibhinnaḥ svacchandasusvacchatamaikadhāmnaḥ| prāsādahastyaśvapayodasindhugiryādi yadvanmaṇidarpaṇādeḥ ||
That difference, and this — not different thence: of the free, most-perfectly-clear one-abode. Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain and the rest — just as of jewel-mirror and the like.
studio chant · gadya · align 0.0
5
आदर्शकुक्षो प्रतिबिम्बकारि सबिम्बकम् स्याद्यदि मानसिद्धम्
स्वच्छन्दसंविन्मुकुरान्तराले भावेषु हेत्वन्तरमस्ति नान्यत्
ādarśakukṣo pratibimbakāri sabimbakaṃ syādyadi mānasiddham |
svacchandasaṃvinmukurāntarāle bhāveṣu hetvantaramasti nānyat ||
If, in a mirror's belly, the reflection-making with-prototype would be mind-proven — then in the interior of the mirror of free consciousness, among things there is no other cause besides.
studio chant · upajati · align 0.0
6
संविद्घनस्तेन परस्त्वमेव त्वय्येव विश्वानि चकासति द्राक्
स्फुरन्ति च त्वन्महसः प्रभावात् त्वमेव चैषाम् परमेशकर्ता
saṃvidghanastena parastvameva tvayyeva viśvāni cakāsati drāk |
sphuranti ca tvanmahasaḥ prabhāvāt tvameva caiṣāṃ parameśakartā ||
O consciousness-dense one — therefore you indeed are supreme; in you indeed the universes shine at once. And they flash forth by the power of your glory; you indeed are also their supreme-Lord maker.
studio chant · upajati · align 0.0
7
इत्थम् स्वसंवेदनमादिसिद्धमसाध्यमात्मानमनीशमीशम्
स्वशक्तिसम्पूर्णवदेशकालम् नित्यम् विभुम् भैरवनाथमीडे
itthaṃ svasaṃvedanamādisiddhamasādhyamātmānamanīśamīśam |
svaśaktisampūrṇavadeśakālaṃ nityaṃ vibhuṃ bhairavanāthamīḍe ||
Thus — self-consciousness, primordially established, unaccomplishable; the self, non-lord, lord; whose place and time are full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.
studio chant · upajati · align 0.0
8
सद्वृत्तसप्तकमिदम् गलितान्यचिन्ताः सम्यक् स्मरन्ति हृदये परमार्थकामाः
ते भैरवीयपरधाम मुहुर्विशन्ति जानन्ति च त्रिजगतीपरमार्थचर्चाम्
sadvṛttasaptakamidaṃ galitānyacintāḥ samyak smaranti hṛdaye paramārthakāmāḥ |
te bhairavīyaparadhāma muhurviśanti jānanti ca trijagatīparamārthacarcām ||
This septad of good conduct — dissolved other thoughts — those desiring the ultimate rightly remember in the heart. Those, O Bhairava's one, again enter the supreme abode, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion of the three worlds.
studio chant · vasantatilaka · align 0.0
